pages.text: The Sokoni Savings Bond is a small-ticket government bond designed for new and small investors. It can be bought and managed from a mobile phone through registered agents. Interest is paid periodically and the face value is returned on maturity. Holders can pledge the bond as security for a loan from participating lenders. The bond is issued in monthly series with a fixed interest rate for each series.

The minimum purchase of the Sokoni Savings Bond is SYN Sh 3,000. Interest earned on the Sokoni Savings Bond is exempt from tax. This guide was issued by the SYN Central Bank for retail investors and is reviewed every year. Readers who need advice on the Sokoni Savings Bond should consult a licensed adviser, because this guide gives information only. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures.
